approval.basis: User explicitly requested product breakdown, repository updates and mapping of these existing five editorials; no new editorial generated.

copy.captionKo: 차콜 재킷 안에 크림 니트와 화이트 셔츠를 겹쳐요. 블랙 플리츠 팬츠와 페니 로퍼로 아래를 연결하고 가는 골드 체인으로 마무리해요.
copy.captionEn: Layer a cream knit and white shirt under charcoal tailoring. Connect black pleated trousers to penny loafers and finish with a fine gold-tone chain.
copy.captionDe: Trage cremefarbenen Strick und ein weißes Hemd unter dem anthrazitfarbenen Blazer. Schwarze Bundfaltenhose und Pennyloafer bilden eine Linie; eine feine goldfarbene Kette ergänzt den Look.
copy.introKo: 차콜 재킷 안에 크림 니트와 화이트 셔츠를 겹쳐요. 블랙 플리츠 팬츠와 페니 로퍼로 아래를 연결하고 가는 골드 체인으로 마무리해요.
copy.introEn: Layer a cream knit and white shirt under charcoal tailoring. Connect black pleated trousers to penny loafers and finish with a fine gold-tone chain.
copy.introDe: Trage cremefarbenen Strick und ein weißes Hemd unter dem anthrazitfarbenen Blazer. Schwarze Bundfaltenhose und Pennyloafer bilden eine Linie; eine feine goldfarbene Kette ergänzt den Look.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 이너의 색과 질감을 드러내요. 어깨와 소매는 자연스럽게 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to show the inner colour and texture. Keep shoulders and sleeves relaxed.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit Farbe und Struktur der inneren Lage sichtbar bleiben. Schultern und Ärmel sitzen locker.
products.altKo: 차콜 울 재킷 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: charcoal textured wool-look hip-length tailored blazer, notch lapels, single breasted dark buttons, lower flap pockets

products.descriptionKo: 니트의 목선과 커프를 아우터 밖으로 조금 드러내요. 밑단은 팬츠 위에 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Show a little neckline and cuff beyond the outer layer. Keep the hem neat above the trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige etwas Ausschnitt und Bündchen unter der äußeren Lage. Ordne den Saum über der Hose.
products.altKo: 크림 크루넥 니트 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: cream fine knit crew-neck sweater, ribbed neck cuffs and hem

products.descriptionKo: 니트 아래에 겹쳐 입고 칼라와 밑단만 조금 보여줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Layer beneath the knit, revealing a little collar and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage das Hemd unter dem Strick und zeige etwas Kragen und Saum.
products.altKo: 화이트 셔츠 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: white cotton-look button shirt, small pointed collar visible above knit, white hem visible below knit

products.descriptionKo: 바지통을 조이지 않고 자연스럽게 떨어뜨려요. 신발 윗부분이 드러나도록 밑단을 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the legs fall naturally and keep the hem clear enough to show the shoes.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die Hosenbeine locker fallen und ordne den Saum so, dass die Schuhe sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 블랙 플리츠 팬츠 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: black matte tailored loose straight-leg pleated trousers, front crease

products.descriptionKo: 팬츠 밑단을 정돈해 앞코와 제품의 간결한 형태를 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Keep the trouser hem neat to reveal the toe and clean shape of the footwear.
products.descriptionDe: Ordne den Hosensaum, damit Schuhspitze und klare Form sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 블랙 페니 로퍼 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair polished black leather-look penny loafers, rounded apron toe, black low soles

products.descriptionKo: 펜던트 없는 가는 체인을 크림 니트 위에 짧게 걸쳐요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear the fine chain without a pendant over the cream knit.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die feine Kette ohne Anhänger über dem cremefarbenen Strick.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 체인 목걸이 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: single delicate gold-tone chain necklace without pendant, arranged oval

reconstructionNotes: Visible details follow the existing source editorial. Hidden backs, full sleeves, closures, waistbands and opposite footwear are conservative reconstructions.
Materials describe visible appearance; brand, fibre composition, price and purchase URL are unverified.
Actual and feels-like temperature values are unknown. Chilly is the existing folder and app classification.
excludedItems: Food, cups, crockery, paper grocery bags and groceries are scene props, not outfit products.
